name: Tower of Eldara
summary: At Azshara’s far northeastern edge, the Tower of Eldara keeps its sealed doors above the Bay of Storms. Though long abandoned, its stone endured the Sundering, while beasts prowl the coast below.

sections.title: A Relic of Ancient Azshara
sections.body:
On a remote cliff northeast of the Bay of Storms, the Tower of Eldara recalls the kaldorei empire that once ruled this coast. Like other ruins in Azshara, it fell into disuse after the Great Sundering. Its entrance remains barred, revealing nothing of the chambers or relics within.

Along the surrounding shores, murlocs wander, makrura claw across the rocks, and hydras hunt. Few travelers dare approach.

faq.q: What is the Tower of Eldara?
faq.answer: The Tower of Eldara rises from a northeastern cliff in Azshara, overlooking the Bay of Storms. Built before the Great Sundering, it belonged to the kaldorei empire that once spanned the region.

faq.q: Can you enter the Tower of Eldara?
aliases: can i go inside tower of eldara
how to open tower of eldara
faq.answer: No. The Tower of Eldara remains sealed against outsiders. Its chambers and vaults are barred to explorers.

faq.q: What threats wander around the tower?
faq.answer: Murlocs, armored makrura, and coastal hydras prowl the rocky bluffs and nearby sandy beaches around the promontory.

faq.q: Where exactly is the tower located?
faq.answer: The Tower of Eldara stands on the far eastern tip of land jutting into the Great Sea, just northeast across the Bay of Storms in Azshara.

angles.text: The Tower of Eldara recalls the grand empire your ancestors ruled before Queen Azshara and the Highborne shattered the ancient world.
Like many Highborne structures across Azshara, the sealed tower may once have echoed with arcane studies before it was locked away from mortal meddling.
